title: Beyond Single-Sentence Prompts: Upgrading Value Alignment Benchmarks with Dialogues and Stories
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The benchmark, C-Plus Values, measures the value alignment of Large Language Models in terms of responsibility and ethics within a Chinese cultural context, using multi-turn dialogues and narrative scenarios to probe for latent biases and moral stances on general societal issues.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on general ethical and responsibility alignment in a non-religious context.
